subtitle: "My contribution: embedded control, electronics and GUI"

::: {.cards}
::: {.card-x}
#### Hardware
- **NI CompactRIO 9024**: real-time controller + FPGA
- **NI 9401** digital I/O → PWM to servos (250 Hz)
- **NI 9215** analog in ← potentiometers
- Power HD 3688HB & Corona DS-929MG servos
- Vishay P11P potentiometers, Interlink FSRs
:::

::: {.card-x}
#### Software (LabVIEW)
- Interpolation filter for smooth trajectory planning
- Desired angle → PWM duty-cycle mapping from benchmark calibration
- GUI: MCP/PIP angle sliders, live desired-vs-actual plots, emergency stop
- Passive-assist mode: full assistance for flexion/extension
:::
:::

## Servo calibration benchmark

PWM duty cycle swept; angle measured via potentiometers.

| Motor | Duty min (%) | Duty max (%) | ROM min (°) | ROM max (°) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| MCP | 22.5 | 52.5 | 0 | 120.49 |
| PIP | 16 | 60 | 0 | 150 |

## Safety by design

FMEA identified four hazards: **hyperextension, joint breakage, electric shock, mechanical failure.** Mitigations: mechanical stops, software-limited duty cycles within safe ROM, emergency stop in the GUI.
